title: Thinking longer
lede: What if a model spent more effort on harder questions?
body: In 2022 researchers found that showing a model worked examples, with the reasoning written out, made it reason step by step too. Sampling several reasoning paths and voting helped more. The implication took two years to land: computation at inference time can substitute for size.

In September 2024 OpenAI's o1 trained that behaviour in with reinforcement learning, producing long hidden reasoning before answering. In January 2025 DeepSeek-R1 reproduced the result openly, showing reasoning can emerge from reinforcement learning alone, and published the method. Within months every major lab offered a model that thinks before it answers.
transition: A model that can reason about a task can also start carrying it out.
